items.title: Chime to Participate in Barclays 24th Annual Global Technology Conference
items.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, November 23, 2026--Chime® (Nasdaq: CHYM) announced today that President and Interim Chief Financial Officer Mark Troughton will participate in a fireside chat at the 24th Barclays Annual Global Technology Conference in San Francisco on Wednesday, December 9, 2026 at 3:45 p.m. Pacific Standard Time.
